E130-R1.what: is B recoded? B's odd bits (1, 3, 5) minus its even bits (0, 2, 4), mean per flipped bit, board fJ
E130-R1.verdicts: RECODED if the 95% interval's low end >= T_B; FLAT if its high end <= T_B; else INCONCLUSIVE; NOT SCORED under 3 kept B blocks

E130-R2.what: is A recoded? A's odd bits minus its even bits
E130-R2.verdicts: RECODED if low end >= T_A; FLAT if high end <= T_A; else INCONCLUSIVE; NOT SCORED under 3 kept A blocks

E130-R3.what: does A's sign bit price rise with a dense held B (B = 0x55 minus B = 1)? It does where A is the multiplicand of every partial-product row, i.e. where A is not recoded
E130-R3.verdicts: RISES if low end >= T_S; FLAT if high end <= T_S; else INCONCLUSIVE; NOT SCORED under 3 kept A blocks

E130-R4.what: which multiplier (the registered primary): the group whose three predicted verdicts no decided rule contradicts
E130-R4.verdicts: one group left with R1-R3 all decided: that group; one left with some INCONCLUSIVE: that group, with '(n of 3 rules decided)'; none left: NONE OF THE FOUR; two or more: INCONCLUSIVE between them; NOT SCORED if R1 or R2 is

E130-R5.what: the shared prediction, A: the sign bit priced the same at both base words (a2_7 / a1_7, Fieller, paired)
E130-R5.verdicts: HOLDS if the 95% interval overlaps the band; FAILS (ABOVE or BELOW) if not; NOT SCORED if unbounded or under 3 kept A blocks

E130-R6.what: the shared prediction, B: b2_7 / b1_7

E130-N.what: each netlist's frozen prediction scored (reported per netlist, not a verdict on the multiplier): each separating statistic against the netlist's own band
E130-N.verdicts: SURVIVES if CONSISTENT (interval overlaps band) on all three separators; else EXCLUDED by the ones it misses; every other statistic and every item are reported CONSISTENT / ABOVE / BELOW beside
